The MMIII glossary gives a standard action for spell-like abilities unless noted, so the sample uses a standard action for Statue. The related spell and the general Revised SRD spell-like timing would take one round, a possible alternate reading.

Both printed blaster DCs equal 10 + half the 15 racial Hit Dice + the respective Constitution modifier, including the Fighter 5 champion. This NPC therefore uses DC 23. This NPC uses untyped weapon damage and a standard action to fire the blaster, since the book gives neither damage type nor firing action.
